hints.title: Iterating Over Valid Subarray Lengths
hints.text: Notice that you can test each candidate subarray length between l and r independently.

hints.title: Window Sum Maintenance
hints.text: For each fixed window length, maintain a running sum across the array in linear time.

hints.title: Positive Sum Minimization
hints.text: Keep track of the minimal sum encountered that is strictly greater than zero.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Sliding windows of each length from l to r are inspected to track minimal positive sum.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Brute-force recomputing sums from scratch takes O(n^3).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(1) memory reusing sliding window sums.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Uses sliding window or prefix sums to evaluate valid lengths in O(n * r).
